`enum Cursor`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.input.cursor` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Cursor.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/input/cursor/Cursor.java)

The shape of the mouse pointer that a node shows while the pointer is over it.

## Description

Give a node a cursor with [`Node.cursor`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-property-cursor); [Change the cursor over a node](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/#change-the-cursor-over-a-node) explains which cursor shows over a node without one and while a node is pressed.

Backend note: the shapes are the standard pointers of the system.
On LWJGL 2, JOID loads them from the native cursors of Windows, macOS or X11.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`DEFAULT`](#Cursor-value-DEFAULT) | The arrow of the system. |
| [`POINTER`](#Cursor-value-POINTER) | The pointing hand that marks something to click. |
| [`TEXT`](#Cursor-value-TEXT) | The I-beam that marks text to edit or select; every text field shows it. |
| [`CROSSHAIR`](#Cursor-value-CROSSHAIR) | A thin cross, for precise picking. |
| [`MOVE`](#Cursor-value-MOVE) | Four arrows, for something to drag in every direction. |
| [`NOT_ALLOWED`](#Cursor-value-NOT_ALLOWED) | A crossed circle, for an action that is not available. |
| [`RESIZE_EW`](#Cursor-value-RESIZE_EW) | A horizontal double arrow, for resizing from a left or right edge. |
| [`RESIZE_NS`](#Cursor-value-RESIZE_NS) | A vertical double arrow, for resizing from a top or bottom edge. |
| [`RESIZE_NWSE`](#Cursor-value-RESIZE_NWSE) | A diagonal double arrow from the top left to the bottom right, for resizing from those corners. |
| [`RESIZE_NESW`](#Cursor-value-RESIZE_NESW) | A diagonal double arrow from the top right to the bottom left, for resizing from those corners. |
